summary: Iteration 146: verified (1) A5 flyer preview with 5 language chips + lightbox, (2) ES/FR flyer assets, (3) TikTok click tracking POST /api/social/click, (4) Admin social report card with 7-day chart, (5) Admin Instagram/Facebook URL fields with dynamic 'Seguici' button, (6) regression on TikTok handle + WhatsApp. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed (new file test_iter146_flyer_social.py). Frontend: all Playwright checks passed on mobile (390x844) and desktop (1920x4000). Final state restored: instagram_url='', facebook_url='', tiktok_handle='mikilab.de' (verified via GET /api/site-settings).

issues: NewsletterPopup (data-testid='newsletter-popup', z-[85], full-screen backdrop) appears a few seconds after load and blocks ALL clicks on the page until dismissed; automated/real users cannot interact with the flyer chips or 'Seguici' buttons while it is open. Not a new regression but it is the single biggest interaction blocker on Home.
Card labels are Italian-only ('Click social (Seguici)', 'TIKTOK · 7 GIORNI') - accepted per spec (AdminPanel IT/DE only).
Days with 0 clicks render as a 1-2px orange line, hard to read as 'zero'; consider a faint baseline track + numeric labels.

critical_code_review_comments: PromuoviMikiLab.jsx builds asset URLs with `${process.env.PUBLIC_URL}/...` — PUBLIC_URL is '' in this build so hrefs resolve correctly ('/locandina-mikilab-es.png'), but other places in the repo use `process.env.PUBLIC_URL || ''`; keep it consistent to avoid '/undefined/...' if the build ever sets it.

POST /api/social/click is unauthenticated and unrate-limited (single $inc per channel/day) — trivially inflatable. Acceptable for vanity metrics; consider IP-based throttling if the number is ever used for decisions.
GET /api/admin/social-report loads the whole social_clicks collection (to_list(20000)) and aggregates in Python; move to a Mongo aggregation with a {channel, day} filter once data grows.
AdminPanel.jsx is 710 lines and server.py 7832 lines — both exceed the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into feature modules/routers.
seed_data_creation: One extra tiktok click row increment via POST /api/social/click (counter is cumulative, harmless). No other data created; IG/FB temporarily set then cleared.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified details — Flyer: chips flyer-lang-{it,de,en,es,fr} switch both the thumbnail src and promuovi-flyer-download href/download attr to /locandina-mikilab.png, -de, -en, -es, -fr; all 5 assets HTTP 200 image/png >10KB; lightbox flyer-lightbox opens on promuovi-flyer-preview, image loads (natural 848x1264, rendered 358x534 on mobile), closes via flyer-lightbox-close AND via backdrop click. Seguici: promuovi-social-tiktok href https://www.tiktok.com/@mikilab.de (handle from GET /api/site-settings), onClick fires POST /api/social/click {"channel":"tiktok"} (captured in network), promuovi-social-whatsapp present, instagram/facebook absent when URLs empty and present (href = saved URL) right after admin save. Admin: card admin-social-report shows social-report-tiktok counter (6 at test time) + 7 day bars (08-25..08-31); admin-site-settings has admin-tiktok-handle, admin-wa-number, admin-instagram-url, admin-facebook-url + admin-save-settings; save persists to GET /api/site-settings. TESTING TIPS: (a) NewsletterPopup overlay must be dismissed first via [data-testid=newsletter-popup-close]; (b) Home is public, no login needed for PromuoviMikiLab; admin login via header [data-testid=login-btn] -> auth-email/auth-password/auth-submit, then site-menu-open -> site-menu-admin; (c) in pytest, logging in on a shared requests.Session sets the session_token cookie — use a fresh requests call for negative auth tests.
rca_of_the_issue: No product defects found. Two initial pytest failures and one Playwright failure were test-harness issues (shared authenticated session for negative auth tests; NewsletterPopup overlay intercepting clicks; `process` not defined inside page.evaluate) and were fixed in the test code.
